reason: The stated purpose is one aria-label on the SuperAdmin search input; the PR also deletes the route-mount-order contract checks in tests/routeMountOrderContract.test.js (the /api/:firmSlug mount must exist, mount after platform routes and before tenant routes, and not be owned by mountPlatformRoutes). After the PR the test no longer checks the mount order; nothing in the purpose requires it.

The freeze tests are rewritten for the new two-source (reload + fill) certification the PR introduces; expected literals change with the design. The new tests still check that the source archives are not mutated and add checks (idempotent rebuild, per-source evidence, hash and tag mismatches fail).

Stated purpose: update the Mergify config. The PR deletes test_run_cmd_rejects_unsafe_arguments and test_branch_name_validator_rejects_unsafe_names, and at the same time loosens scripts/alignment/check_alignment.py: _SAFE_ARG goes from an anchored ^[...]+$ to an unanchored [...]* used with match(), so arguments with unsafe characters are no longer rejected. Nothing checks argument or branch-name rejection afterwards; the purpose does not require it.
Expected strings change to the new resume content the PR syncs (new employer, skill list); the purpose requires it and the tests still check the same rendered content, with one assertion added.
Source-contains assertions are updated to the new My Tasks layout the PR builds (title row, metadata row); five assertions replace three, the purpose requires it.
Expected counts and names grow to include the implied conjugated port definitions the PR adds (stated purpose); the PR also adds new tests for the conjugate.

The deleted AccessibleWrapper.test.tsx tested the custom AccessibleWrapper component (Enter/Space activation, disabled state). The PR removes the component and replaces every use with Fluent UI Card role=button, in line with its stated purpose of consolidating on Fluent UI; the test left together with its subject. Borderline: keyboard activation of those cards is no longer tested in the repository.
Assertions move from --cached-jsonl to --cached-logs and to the shard-based ingest/hash steps, which is the stated change; checks are added, not dropped.

The PR deliberately removes the /kill and /resume commands (the sim bot becomes read-only under the new Telegram constitution, stated in the body); the kill/resume tests are replaced by tests asserting the commands are gone and absent from /start.

The PR reimplements the ledger unit with a new API (its stated purpose) and moves its test from packages/301.spatial/test/ledger.test.ts to 19.ledger.unit/test/ledger.test.ts, rewritten for the new API (git sees delete + add, not a rename). The new file checks key ordering, NaN/Infinity rejection, the genesis link, chaining, tamper detection and schema rejection. Borderline: the old '-0 becomes 0' canonicalization case is not carried over.
Expected explanation text and the guidance link change to the new resident wording and URL the PR adds (stated purpose); the code-provenance checks are kept.
The rollout.currentWawe sync check is kept (message reworded); three AI PLATE sync checks and many package assertions are added. Additive change, as stated.

The PR's stated purpose is removing the last fake track segment; getTrackGeometry now returns no features and the test asserts exactly that (length 0), dropping the per-feature shape loop that has nothing left to check.

The card-style test is replaced by tests for the flat Flight-style sections the PR introduces (stated purpose); the filter-content test is kept with a renamed title and two new geometry/theme tests are added.
